sources: Wild Wanderer (5-star Arts Unit). Skills 1-2 (wpn_attr_wisd_mid: Intellect; wpn_sp_attr_electrondam_mid: Electric DMG) and skill 3's Arts Intensity +phy_spell_up (sk_wpn_funnel_0004 cardAttributeModifier attribute 87; SkillPatchTable L1-L9 10-28) are in the stat panel.

sk_wpn_funnel_0004 passiveEventActions: abilityEvent 206 + CheckBuffIdInContext checkType 1 tag 1466867135 (Electrification: the reaction buffs buff_common_pulse_<el>_triggered and the forced buff_common_pulse_pulse_conduct_triggered_do carry it) → CreateBuff buff_wpn_funnel_0004_up on the team (targetSource 3, wielder included; asChildBuff): attributes 50 (Physical DMG) and 52 (Electric DMG) + dmg_up (L1-L9 0.08-0.224) for duration (15 s), stackingType 11 with priority key dmg_up and maxStackCnt 1, so the loader puts it in one stack group across wielders (open list B2: the strongest acts). Description: "When the wielder applies Electrification, the team gains Physical DMG Dealt and Electric DMG Dealt +{dmg_up} for {duration}s. Effects of the same name cannot stack."

Forced Electrification fires it (in-game test 68 part 2, 2026-11-18: all 21 listed starts in 3aa6, 4d60, c6d8 and d774 are at Perlica's combo hits); a reaction Electrification is the interim (U3: no log has one with the weapon). beforeDamage (2026-11-22): the applying hit already has it, as Pulser Labs' and P3's buffs on the same tag (abilityEvent 102) and Rational Farewell's on abilityEvent 206 + a status tag: every Perlica combo hit in 3aa6 and d774 that the replay made without it was logged ×1.103 (skill-3 level 8: dmg_up 0.192) and ×1.142 (level 9: 0.224) of the engine, i.e. 1 + dmg_up over the hit's DMG Dealt sum; with it they match plain (3aa6 4, d774 4, c6d8 2, 4d60 2 of 4). ZMDLogs doesn't list it on that hit (the listing is taken before the hit's own applications, as for P3 and Pulser Labs). The earlier reading (after the damage, from Arcane's abilityEvent 206 logged 4 frames after its buff in fixtures/pending/zmdlogs-d9e59d0fb737.json) is ruled out for this weapon.
